ZipHatch — a private, offline-first archive app: unpack a ZIP without keeping a second copy. Extract in place and reclaim the source, or use smart extraction for encrypted, split and read-only archives. ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR and more. Free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hatchstudio.archive #androidapps #productivity #zip
